idea: Treat the best count for a rectangle of aspect r as a piecewise-linear function g_m(r) and compute its breakpoints exactly in Fractions. Build it recursively from g for smaller counts by taking upper envelopes over the cut position. Optimal cuts can then sit at any rational breakpoint instead of only at denominators ≤ 12, and the unit square is just g_n(1).
